events.text: Employer dates abandonment from this day.

redTeam.intro: Best arguments available to Northbridge, ranked by expected impact.

chat.question: Which contradictions in the evidence undercut abandonment?
chat.answer: Two contradictions do real work against abandonment: the termination letter dates it from 4 August, but payroll logs attendance through 8 August.

chatResponse.question: Can the employer still rely on abandonment as a ground for dismissal?
chatResponse.source: ilovelawyer · from evidence & timeline, law & precedent
chatResponse.answer: Unlikely. Abandonment needs absence without valid reason and a clear intent to sever employment. Payroll shows attendance through 8 August, and the complaint was filed within a week, which is inconsistent with an intent to abandon.

chat.question: Which documents support the argument that the claimant was maintained?
chat.source: ilovelawyer · AI assessment · from evidence & timeline
chat.answer: The bank statements (pp.14–37) show recurring transfers from the deceased through 2023. That supports a maintenance argument, subject to verifying the purpose of the transfers and the claimant's financial circumstances.

chatResponse.question: Does the claimant have standing under the Inheritance Act 1975?
chatResponse.source: ilovelawyer · from evidence & timeline, law & precedent
chatResponse.answer: Likely yes, under s.1(1)(e) as a person maintained by the deceased. The bank statements show recurring transfers through 2023. That still depends on showing the transfers were maintenance and not gifts.

arguments.title: It was a joint investment that failed
arguments.note: Evidence: draft investment memo in the defendant's answer
arguments.response: Response: the payment was induced by a false statement of fact

arguments.title: The permit statement was a forecast, not a fact
arguments.note: Evidence: the KakaoTalk thread read as a whole
arguments.response: Response: “already issued” states a present fact

arguments.title: No proof the permit was never applied for
arguments.response: Response: ask the district office for an official certificate

chat.question: Which documents show the permit statement came before the payment?
chat.source: ilovelawyer · AI assessment · from evidence & timeline
chat.answer: The KakaoTalk screenshots (p.3) show the “already issued” message on 11월 2일, and the bank records (row 14) show the payment on 11월 4일. That supports a statement made to induce the payment, subject to proving the permit was never issued.

chatResponse.question: Can Ms Kim rescind the payment for fraud?
chatResponse.source: ilovelawyer · from evidence & timeline, law & precedent
chatResponse.answer: Likely yes, under Civil Act art. 110(1): an intention induced by fraud can be rescinded. The KakaoTalk message came two days before the payment. She still has to prove the statement was false, which needs the district office's record.

relatedCasesItems_UK.snippet: A dismissal can be unfair if the employer skipped a fair procedure, even with a good reason to dismiss.

relatedCasesItems_UK.snippet: In a misconduct dismissal: genuine belief, reasonable grounds, and a reasonable investigation.

relatedCasesItems_KR.title: Civil Act, Article 750
relatedCasesItems_KR.snippet: A person who causes damage to another by an unlawful act, intentionally or negligently, is liable to compensate for it.
